agents.name: Research Lead
agents.role: Route work, enforce stage barriers, and assemble evidence. Never approve or execute orders.

agents.name: Data Quality
agents.role: Verify point-in-time data, trading calendar, source completeness, and manifest hashes.

agents.name: Market Analysts
agents.role: Produce bounded fundamental, sentiment, news, and technical evidence from archived inputs.

agents.name: Strategy Research
agents.role: Challenge claims, compare bull and bear cases, and separate evidence from inference.

agents.name: Paper Trader
agents.role: Translate research into versioned proposals. Never bypass plan_hash approval or the T+1 model.

agents.name: Risk Manager
agents.role: Independently check portfolio, market, liquidity, limit, suspension, lot, and cost constraints.

agents.name: Audit Verifier
agents.role: Check artifacts, hashes, tests, replay evidence, and maker-checker separation before review.

workflow.name: daily_research
workflow.trigger: trading-day schedule or explicit manual issue
workflow.failure_policy: resume the failed step only when its input and prompt hashes still match

autopilot.title: A股每日研究
autopilot.freeze_reason: User requested pause; remote update failed: server unreachable / DNS resolution failure
